title: Ship owner-consented WebRTC desktop video and authenticated control, with verified Wayland startup recovery.
changes: Add the opt-in native Linux WebRTC media bridge and desktop_webrtc_offer, desktop_webrtc_heartbeat and desktop_webrtc_stop runtime tools for owner-approved, single-session desktop video; input remains on the authenticated device RPC path and is never authorized by media alone.

Require an explicit per-session site consent, owner-bound signaling, Redis-fenced admission and fail-closed Stop quarantine; public origins and multi-replica deployments remain disabled without the shared distributed lease.
Add the workspace Screen Preview module and opt-in WebRTC viewer/control UI; video grants no keyboard, pointer, clipboard or audio access by itself.
Discover GNOME Mutter display geometry for a real user-session bus when a managed Linux agent starts without graphical environment variables; do not invent displays or grant screen capture.
Import a narrowly allowlisted Wayland environment only after verifying the current-user runtime directory and socket; preserve explicit X11/TTY sessions.
Reject unsafe directory permissions, symlink aliases, stale session context and asynchronously changed graphical settings; retain fail-closed headless behavior.
Add deterministic Linux/extended-tool regressions and verify the public runtime projection and package contents on ASUS. Windows/macOS native release validation remains a gate.
